name: native-node-pointer

baseline.revisionLabel: Preserved original native tsc-ts; historical build sidecar absent

methodology: Direct original native artifact versus retained three-node-table Go, only after both independent confirmations pass. Nine alternating pairs TypeORM/tRPC and five VSCode/Sentry, one warmup, matched GNU-time/RSS wrappers and physical inputs, default runtime/checker settings. Native worker count is not assumed equal to Go. All samples retained; no historical ratio multiplication. Native artifact has no historical build sidecar.
